scope: Save/load lot 13: native state. Save support of the engine-implemented classes, sky and PolyGrid republication after a load, the VoiceMgr and CommLink client state across a load, and the CTF refusal path. No original code is imported; the publication check, CVoiceMgr::InheritAcrossLoad and the CTF refusals are OpenBlood2 code.

references.purpose: Class flags of every engine class: CF_ALWAYSLOAD for Model, WorldModel, Container, Sprite, Sound, StartPoint, World, Brush, DemoSkyWorldModel, SkyPointer and FogSphere (engineobjects.c:176-855); CF_NORUNTIME for the lights, OutsideDef, FastApproxArea, ProjectorSprite and RaySelecter.
PolyGrid is CF_ALWAYSLOAD (PolyGrid.cpp:39): runtime surfaces are never saved.
The Load tail recreating the surface PolyGrid (VolumeBrush.cpp:866), the basis of the exactly-once surface check.

StartNewGame (BloodClientShell.cpp:3910-3964) calling VoiceMgr Reset on every load and leaving m_CommLink untouched; the client process (and the voice manager's on/off state, random state and group choices) persisting across a load.
Reset clearing the unique-play flags and the next play time (VoiceMgr.cpp:843-860), StopAll (VoiceMgr.cpp:814-830).
CCommLink has no save or reset path; its panel runs on its own clock.
The Save menu item disabled in a multiplayer game (MainMenus.cpp:809).
FlagObject and FlagStand (FlagObjects.cpp:39, 483) have no save code and are never marked saveable.
